description:
Featured in App Of The Day and New Apps We Love.

Moodboard is the simplest way to create beautiful freeform photo and video collages, moodboards and vision boards. Combine photos and videos with stylish text options to build your own layouts to share with your followers or save for yourself. Easily erase backgrounds from images to isolate your subject. Share directly to Instagram stories, Instagram Feed, TikTok, create home screen widgets or export to your Photo Library. Choose from iPhone Wallpaper, Instagram Stories 9:16 portrait, 4:3, square or landscape Moodboard canvas sizes. Set the background, border and text color from preset colors, a custom color picker or using the eyedropper tool to select colors from photos and videos to match the overall aesthetic.

TEMPLATES
Choose from dozens of moodboard and vision board templates to speed up your Moodboard creation.

FREEFORM CANVAS
Create your own way. Add up to 10 frames and make the most of your layout. Zoom in and out to view your project up close or all at once.

STOCK PHOTOS & GOOGLE IMAGE SEARCH
Unsplash stock photo library with 1,000,000+ images to choose from.

EASILY REMOVE BACKGROUNDS
Easily remove backgrounds from images to isolate your subject. Perfect for outfit inspo or interior mood boards.

POST TO SOCIAL INSTANTLY
When you’re ready Moodboard will take you directly to Instagram and Tiktok to share your work.

SAVE AS SWIPE THROUGH CAROUSEL
Your design will be saved as a series of photos/videos your followers can swipe through.

CREATE HOMESCREEN WIDGETS
Easily create iOS homescreen widgets to quickly access your vision boards, remember your goals, practice manifestation, affirmation and more. Empowering you with positivity every time you unlock your phone.

VISION BOARDS
Create visual representations of your goals and affirmations.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Several advanced features are available as a monthly subscription called Moodboard Pro. Moodboard Pro will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your subscription and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
Terms of Use: http://moodboardapp.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://moodboardapp.com/privacy/

Follow @moodboardapp on Instagram for inspiration from our community of users. Add the #moodboardapp hashtag on your Moodboard's to join the community and get a shout out on our page.
We love hearing your ideas and feedback. Please DM us on Instagram at @moodboardapp for questions or suggestions.
